# Link titles

A [single-quoted title](https://example.com 'The example site') and a [double-quoted title](https://example.com "The example site").

A [parenthesised title](https://example.com (The example site)) and an [angle destination](<https://example.com/a b> 'With a space').

An image with a title: ![alt text](image.png 'An image') and ![another](image.png (Another image)).

Extra whitespace: [padded](https://example.com   'Padded'   ) and a title on its own line: [wrapped](https://example.com
'Wrapped title').

An escaped quote: [quoted](https://example.com 'It\'s here') and two links to one destination: [bare](https://example.com) and [bracketed](<https://example.com>).

A reference link with a titled definition: [defined][ref].

[ref]: https://example.com 'Defined title'
